parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Splunk On-Call destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-victorops` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the `apprise` channels the gateway composes an Apprise `victorops://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` transformer channels instead POST a native VictorOps alert payload directly to your Splunk On-Call REST endpoint, bypassing Apprise: `gateway` is free, direct to your REST endpoint, and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Splunk On-Call destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Splunk On-Call destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Splunk On-Call REST endpoint (no Apprise)
parameters.gateway_url_plus: ${ customer_secrets.VICTOROPS_BASE ?? https://alert.victorops.com }/integrations/generic/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }/alert/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.routing_key_secret }} }

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Splunk On-Call API key (api_id path segment)

routing_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Splunk On-Call routing key
